    StartersCantina chips and salsa rojaFried tortilla chips with a charred tomato and dried chilli salsaHow to make it12 corn tortillas1 L vegetable oil, for frying4 tomatoes2 dried chillies2 cloves of garlic1/2 white onionsalt, to tasteSoak the dried chillies in hot water and cut the tortillas into wedges.Fry the wedges in oil at 180°C in batches until crisp, drain and salt.Char the tomatoes, chillies, garlic and onion in a dry pan.Blitz the charred mix rough with salt and serve with the chips.Plaza elote with chipotle mayoGrilled corn brushed with chipotle lime mayo and rolled in fetaHow to make it4 corn cobs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 chipotle in adobo, chopped2 limes100g feta1 tsp chilli powder1 small handful corianderBoil the corn cobs.Grill over high heat, turning, until charred all over.Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle and the juice of one lime.Brush the hot corn with the mayo, roll in crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder and coriander.Serve with lime wedges.Day of the Dead concha bunsThe Day of the Dead paradeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft sweet yeasted buns with a crackly vanilla and cocoa sugar shell scored in a shell pattern, baked golden and served warm with butter.Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 80g caster sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml warm milk, 80g soft butter and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead 10 minutes.Prove 1 hour, then shape 12 balls.Rub 100g icing sugar, 100g plain flour and 80g butter into a paste, split it and mix cocoa into half.Press a disc onto each bun and score a shell pattern.Prove 40 minutes and bake at 180°C for 18 minutes.Sopes with refried beans and quesoMexi-can or Mexi-can't? Sands wants to know.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsPuerco pibil, banana leaf porkPork shoulder marinated in achiote and citrus, wrapped in banana leaves, roasted 4 hoursHow to make it1.2kg pork shoulder50g achiote paste2 oranges3 limes4 cloves of garlic2 tsp ground cumin2 tsp dried oregano1 packet banana leaves1 red onion16 corn tortillasMix the achiote with orange and lime juice, garlic, cumin and oregano and coat the pork.Marinate overnight in the fridge.Wrap the pork in banana leaves and then foil.Roast at 160°C until it falls apart.Slice the red onion and quick pickle it in lime juice and salt while the pork rests.Shred the pork and serve with the pickled onion and warm tortillas.Chicken in red mole with riceThe coup and the festivalHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs simmered in a rich red mole of dried chillies, tomato, almonds, sesame, cinnamon and dark chocolate, served on rice with toasted sesame.Toast 4 dried guajillo chillies, then soak in 500ml hot chicken stock for 20 minutes.Fry an onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tomatoes, 50g almonds, 2 tbsp sesame seeds and 1 tsp cinnamon.Blitz with the chillies, stock and 40g dark chocolate until smooth.Brown 1kg chicken thighs, pour over the sauce and simmer 40 minutes.Serve on rice with more toasted sesame.SweetsMexican chocolate flanCaramel custard flan flavoured with dark chocolate and cinnamonHow to make it230g caster sugar, divided400ml full cream milk100ml thickened cream80g dark chocolate1 tsp ground cinnamon4 eggsMelt most of the sugar to a golden caramel and pour into four ramekins.Warm the milk and cream with the chocolate and cinnamon until smooth.Whisk the eggs with the remaining sugar and whisk in the warm milk.Strain over the caramel and set the ramekins in a deep tray with hot water.Bake in the water bath at 150°C until just set with a slight wobble.Chill, then run a knife around the edge and turn out.DrinksTequila with sangrita
